observation.initial_state: A star-shaped arrangement of dominoes is set up on a wooden floor. Eight colored arms (yellow, green, blue, dark blue, purple, pink, red, orange) radiate from a central point, connected by short black segments. A long line of black dominoes extends horizontally across the bottom foreground and connects vertically to the center.
visible_changes: From 0.0s to roughly 12.0s, the entire structure remains static with no movement observed.
Around 13.0s, the black connecting segments near the center begin to topple inward toward the middle.
By 15.0s, the collapse reaches the base of the colored arms; the innermost dominoes of the red, pink, purple, and dark blue arms fall first.

Between 16.0s and 20.0s, the falling motion propagates outward along all eight colored arms simultaneously, creating a symmetrical collapsing pattern where the dominoes lie flat progressively away from the center.
observation.final_state: The inner portions of all eight colored arms and their black connectors have collapsed into a pile at the center, while the outer tips of the arms remain standing upright.
uncertain_details: The specific trigger or cause for the initial collapse of the central black segments is not visible in the clip.
It is unclear if the horizontal line at the bottom was intended to be part of the chain reaction, as it does not move during the clip.
